## Risk flags (check any that apply — see GEMINI.md §4, adapt these to your project)

- [ ] Touches a high-stakes domain calculation/rule (see GEMINI.md §4)
- [ ] Adds a new dependency or third-party service
- [ ] Touches authentication or credential storage
- [ ] Changes a core data model
- [ ] Adds a new external integration/connector

## Definition of done

- [ ] Task List reviewed and approved
- [ ] Implementation Plan reviewed and approved (if non-trivial)
- [ ] Tests written and passing
- [ ] Walkthrough produced
- [ ] Artifacts logged to docs/agent-logs/
